[SWS_DM_01784] Service Validation of SOVD Requests
⌈
On reception of
an SOVD request the DM shall call the according ara::diag::SovdServiceVal-
idation::Validate for each DiagnosticSovdServiceValidationPortMap-
ping configured in DiagnosticServiceValidationConfiguration in the order
configured. If any ara::diag::SovdServiceValidation::Validate returns an
error, then the DM shall immediately return an error to the client and not proceed pro-
cessing the request any further.
⌋
